name: switch
title: Switch
description: Binary setting: a two-cell frame whose block stretches to the on side.

.kl-switch-thumb.transition: inset-inline-start calc(var(--kl-stretch-trail) * 1ms) var(--kl-ease-out), inset-inline-end calc(var(--kl-stretch-lead) * 1ms) var(--kl-ease-out), background-color 0s linear calc(var(--kl-stretch-lead) * 0.35ms)

.kl-switch[data-checked] .kl-switch-thum.transition: inset-inline-start calc(var(--kl-stretch-lead) * 1ms) var(--kl-ease-out), inset-inline-end calc(var(--kl-stretch-trail) * 1ms) var(--kl-ease-out), background-color 0s linear calc(var(--kl-stretch-lead) * 0.35ms)
